text:
leila_sales: Heads-up — BetaRetail POC blocked. They can't provision users via Okta SCIM. Demo scheduled tomorrow and they're stuck.
sam_se: Any error logs? even a tiny Okta event helps.
leila_sales: From their support chat: `POST /scim/v2/Users -> 400 Bad Request - \"unknown attribute: department\"` They map department in Okta and expect it to land as an extension.
eric_enginfra: Hmm we don't throw on unknown attrs normally. Which tenant? betaretail-poc-21
sophie_sec: We did flip on strict validation for a security sweep last week for a handful of tenants. Maybe that one got toggled.
eric_enginfra: Confirmed: scim.strictValidation=true for betaretail-poc-21. I'll flip to false for POC and audit the change.
deploy-bot: config change: tenant=betaretail-poc-21 key=scim.strictValidation old=true new=false by eric_enginfra at 2026-03-21T09:05:40Z
leila_sales: Sending updated guidance to BetaRetail to retry. Also noted they used the token we generated earlier.
leila_sales: They came back with 403 Forbidden when posting to /scim/v2/Users.
sam_se: 403 suggests token doesn't have scim:write or token tenant mismatch.
eric_enginfra: Which token was it? we have two token flavors: control-plane tokens (scim scopes) and runtime keys for inference. They used the runtime key.
leila_sales: Ah. They copied the key from the Dedicated pool config page — thought it was the SCIM key.
eric_enginfra: Oof. I'll issue a control-plane scoped, short-lived token and paste a secure link. Also remind them about tenant header if they use shared endpoint.
deploy-bot: token created: tenant=betaretail-poc-21 scopes=[scim:read,scim:write] expires=2026-03-21T15:04:12Z — link: https://redwood-internal/secrets/abcd (internal)
leila_sales: Sent the link through the secure channel.
leila_sales: Now they report 401 Unauthorized.
sam_se: 401 could be wrong endpoint or missing X-Redwood-Tenant header (common), or they called the dedicated control plane which requires private routing.
eric_enginfra: Quick checklist to send them:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <control-plane-token>
X-Redwood-Tenant: betaretail-poc-21
Content-Type: application/scim+json

{ "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "userName":"alice@betaretail.com", "name":{"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"W"}, "emails":[{"value":"alice@betaretail.com","type":"work"}] }
```
eric_enginfra: If they are hitting `https://betaretail-poc-21-control.redwood.private` they need VPN or VPC peering.
leila_sales: Passed that along. They replied Okta still shows `SAML group claim missing` for SSO users.
sophie_sec: For SAML we expect group claim under `groups` or the OID `urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.5923.1.1.1`. If the IdP sends `memberOf` we can accept it via fallback list.
eric_enginfra: I'll add `memberOf` to saml.attributeFallbacks for the tenant now.
deploy-bot: tenant=betaretail-poc-21 saml.attributeFallbacks updated to ["urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.5923.1.1.1","groups","memberOf"] by eric_enginfra
sam_se: Also note: if they want SCIM to push groups, enable scim.groupsEnabled and request the scim:groups scope. That requires a separate consent screen in the console.
eric_enginfra: Enabling groups for POC.
deploy-bot: config change: tenant=betaretail-poc-21 key=scim.groupsEnabled old=false new=true by eric_enginfra
leila_sales: I've asked their IdP admin to re-run provisioning and confirm which endpoint and token they're using. I'll update after they test.
sophie_sec: Quick answer for their security questionnaire: SCIM payloads are redacted in logs by default; we can enable tenant audit logs that store hashed identifiers. I'll DM the docs.
sam_se: Nice. If they can create at least one user we can move to performance tests. Keep me posted.
leila_sales: Will do. Action items: eric toggle strict -> done, issue control-plane token -> done, add saml fallbacks -> done, enable scim groups -> done. Sending recap to BetaRetail now. :thumbsup:
